description: NITROX II In-Line Security Processors Product Description: The NITROXII CN2130 is one member of the Cavium Networks award winning NITROX,NITROX Lite, and NITROX II line of security processors. Based on acommon hardware processor core, the NITROX families deliver 50Mbs to10Gbps of encryption bandwidth with 1K to 40K RSA/DH operations persecond. NITROX processors and acceleration boards are being used byserver-motherboard vendors and OEMs in a wide range of networkingequipment to accelerate security protocols and algorithms.
